results.explanation: Builds hydrogen and ammonia export corridors linking North Africa, East Africa and European ports, with working groups on offtake standards and port infrastructure. It matches your focus on export corridors in North Africa.

Dr. Samuel Mwangi, Secretary General at the East Africa Power Pool Secretariat, has advised on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia shipping. You already know each other through the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition.
The East Africa Power Pool Secretariat works on green hydrogen and climate finance in Africa and takes part in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition, which builds export corridors from North Africa.

Designs reskilling programmes for workers moving into renewable energy and hydrogen jobs in Africa and Asia-Pacific. It is less directly about export corridors but relates to the green hydrogen workforce.

Lumière Institute of Technology, based in France, works on green hydrogen in Europe. It is a partner for European-side work on hydrogen corridors rather than a North African or Middle Eastern contact.

Victoria Hale, Chair & CEO of Atlas Logistics, advises on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia shipping and is active in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition. Known for well-connected introductions, though not Gulf-focused in her profile.

Ahmed Khalil, Director of Energy Transition at Gulf Sovereign Capital, sources hydrogen and ammonia projects in MENA and advises on export corridors, so is well placed to speak on Gulf investor appetite. Named as joining the hydrogen offtake working group as an observer.

Laila Al-Suwaidi, CEO of Gulf Sovereign Capital, works on electrolyser deployment and long-term green hydrogen offtake, and sets the fund's investment strategy. Principal-level contact, so introductions go through the Managing Director.

Omar Al-Mansoori, Managing Director of Energy Investments at Gulf Sovereign Capital, leads the fund's hydrogen stakes and works on electrolyser deployment and offtake agreements. All contact is managed by the Secretariat.
Shares these words with the request: ceo.

Prof. Klaus Weber directs the European Climate Finance Institute and has led green bond and transition-finance programmes for emerging markets. He also attended the Ocean finance breakfast on blue bonds and guarantees.

Julia Schmidt is a Senior Economist at the European Climate Finance Institute who has led green bond and transition-finance programmes for emerging markets. She also works on resilient trade routes and nearshoring.

Victoria Hale, Chair & CEO of Atlas Logistics, structures blended-finance vehicles that crowd private capital into transition projects. She is also named in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition Annual Report 2026 for chairing port infrastructure.

Dr. Samuel Mwangi, Secretary General of the East Africa Power Pool Secretariat, structures blended-finance vehicles for transition projects. He is also named in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition Annual Report 2026.

Rafael Ortega Ruiz, Innovation Director at Andes AgriTech in Colombia, works on climate-resilient agriculture and credit products for smallholders. You already know each other from a co-attended session on digital credit for small producers in June 2026.
Andes AgriTech, based in Peru, works on food security and financial inclusion. It runs the Water-Food Nexus Lab, which pilots joint water and agriculture interventions in the Andes.

Thabo Nkosi, CEO of Ubuntu Microfinance in South Africa, expands access to microfinance and digital credit. You have previously worked together, and Nkosi sits in the Inclusive Digital Finance Alliance on credit scoring for the unbanked.

Isabel Fernández, President of Banco Solidario de las Américas in Mexico, expands microfinance and digital credit for smallholders. She attended the June 2026 session on digital credit for small producers, which you also attended.

Tomás Herrera, Digital Finance Director at Banco Solidario de las Américas in Mexico, works on digital lending for smallholders. He also took part in the June 2026 digital credit session with you and sits in the Inclusive Digital Finance Alliance.

Dr. Léa Fontaine dirige la recherche sur l'hydrogène au Lumière Institute et travaille sur les coûts de production en Afrique du Nord, un sujet de panel pertinent. Elle est aussi citée dans un e-mail sur le panel hydrogène de Genève.
Dr. Marcus Feld est conseiller senior en hydrogène au Lumière Institute, avec une expertise sur les corridors d'exportation et le transport d'ammoniac. Flag: opted out of matchmaking.
Aïssatou Diallo dirige les programmes eau de Sahara Solar Holdings et travaille aussi sur les contrats d'achat d'hydrogène vert. Elle a participé à une visite de terrain sur le lien eau-alimentation.

Ahmed Khalil dirige la transition énergétique chez Gulf Sovereign Capital et suit les projets d'hydrogène et d'ammoniac au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique du Nord. Il rejoindra un groupe de travail sur l'achat d'hydrogène à partir de novembre.

Hamza Rachidi est ingénieur en chef pour les électrolyseurs chez Sahara Solar Holdings, au Maroc. Il est recommandé dans un e-mail sur le panel de Genève pour piloter les électrolyseurs du projet Noor Atlantic.

Mikko Tamm, Director at CyberShield Alliance, works on cyber resilience for critical infrastructure and on AI policy dialogue. Tamm also sits in the Responsible AI Charter and the Cyber Resilience Pact, covering both areas.
Dr. Nadia Petrova, Head of AI Policy at CyberShield Alliance, focuses on AI policy and regulation. Petrova is a participant in the Responsible AI Charter on AI risk management.

Hiroshi Tanaka, Chief Scientist at Singapore Digital Trust Lab, builds frameworks for responsible AI and model risk oversight. Tanaka has also built incident-response cooperation between public and private operators.

Arjun Mehta, CTO at FutureSkills Foundation, works on practical frameworks for responsible AI and model risk oversight. Mehta has also built incident-response cooperation between public and private operators.
Shares these words with the request: ai; related words: responsible, risk; same theme: ai-governance. An introduction is possible through Victoria Hale.

Nguyen Thi Lan, Executive Director at Mekong Water Partnership in Vietnam, works on water scarcity, irrigation efficiency and river-basin management, and scales agritech for food security. They attended a Mekong delta field visit on the water-food nexus.

Dr. Ong Mei Ling, Director of Basin Finance at Mekong Water Partnership, works on water scarcity, irrigation efficiency and river-basin management. They attended the Mekong delta water-food nexus field visit, which discussed basin-level water financing.

Pedro Alves, Head of Agronomy at Andes AgriTech in Brazil, scales agritech that raises yields and works on water scarcity and irrigation. They take part in the Water-Food Nexus Lab, which pilots joint water and agriculture work in Asia.

Mekong Water Partnership, based in Vietnam, covers water, food security and ocean themes in the Asia-Pacific region. It runs the Water-Food Nexus Lab, which pilots joint water and agriculture interventions in the Mekong.

The Water-Food Nexus Lab pilots joint water and agriculture interventions in the Mekong, a direct match for water scarcity and food systems in Asia. Its participants include Nguyen Thi Lan and Dr. Ong Mei Ling.

The Resilient Supply Chains Dialogue brings together shippers, producers and trade officials on supply-chain risk across Africa and Europe, a fit for a critical-minerals miner. Ben Carter, Dr. Kofi Mensah and David Moreau take part.

Project Tidewater is a co-investment platform for African battery-mineral processing, directly relevant to critical minerals. Laila Al-Suwaidi, Liam O'Connor and Kwame Asante are involved, and it is named in the draft investment memorandum D-02.

Ingrid Solberg, Ocean Programme Lead at Pacific Ocean Trust, works on marine conservation finance and blue bonds, and takes part in the Blue Economy Accelerator, which prepares blue-bond pipelines for island states.

Ana Costa, Ocean Finance Lead at Northstar Impact Partners, works on marine conservation finance and blue bonds and is a participant in the Blue Economy Accelerator's blue-bond pipelines for island states.

Nguyen Thi Lan, Executive Director at Mekong Water Partnership, works on blue bonds and marine conservation finance, and also on water and food-security programmes, which fits an ocean finance request only partly.
Kalesi Naivalu, Director at Pacific Ocean Trust, structures blended-finance vehicles for transition projects and takes part in the Blue Economy Accelerator's blue-bond pipelines for island states.
The Blue Economy Accelerator prepares blue-bond pipelines for Pacific and Atlantic island states, directly matching the request for people working on ocean conservation finance.

The Responsible AI Charter is a voluntary AI risk management charter signed by 40 member organisations and publishes annual implementation reviews, making it the main responsible AI initiative in these matches.
Mikko Tamm, Director at CyberShield Alliance in Estonia, works on AI governance and policy dialogues between governments and industry, and is linked to the Responsible AI Charter.
